quoteIntro:
Dear David,
Thank you for the opportunity to provide a quote for your upcoming groundwork.
Please find your itemised quotation below. I hope it meets your requirements, and I’d be delighted to discuss any questions you may have.

terms.title: General Notes & Terms
terms.text: Price based on normal ground conditions. Any unforeseen underground services, drainage issues or unexpected works will be discussed prior to execution.

terms.title: Lawn & Planting Care
terms.text: Aftercare: Freshly laid turf and new planting require daily watering by the client following installation. Petrie Landscapes LTD cannot be held responsible for foliage degradation due to lack of watering.

terms.title: Payment Milestones (25% / 50% / 25%)
terms.text: Payment Terms: 25% deposit required upon order confirmation, 50% progress payment due midway through works, and 25% final balance due upon completion.

terms.title: Quote Expiry Date (30 Days)
terms.text: Quote Expiry: This quotation is valid for 30 days from the date of issue. Prices may be subject to review thereafter due to material cost fluctuations.

terms.title: Site Access & Utilities
terms.text: Site Access: Client to provide clear, uninterrupted access to the working area, as well as access to working electricity and a mains water supply throughout project duration.

terms.title: Standard Ground Conditions
terms.text: Price based on normal ground conditions. Any unforeseen underground services, drainage issues, or unexpected concrete/rock excavation will be discussed prior to execution.

terms.title: Work Duration and Start Date
terms.text: We estimate the work will take 3 weeks weather permitting.Our speculasated start date is 25th December 2027

items.title: Manhole Cover Adjustments
items.desc:
• Supply and install recessed manhole covers

items.title: Steps Construction & Cladding
items.desc:
• Construct new steps at the front door
• Clad existing steps leading up to the property from the pavement in porcelain to match surrounding areas

items.title: Bespoke Porcelain Cladded Raised Planters
items.desc:
• Install concrete things
• Block work to create planter beds
• Choice of porcelain cladding for facings of planter

• Planters to be infilled with premium top soil
• Grouting with tuff joint utility
• Corners of porcelain beds for the cladding to be mitred for a clean seem-less finish

items.title: Replacing Main Step Entrance from Roadside

items.desc:
